Tax on distributed earnings (Estonian model in Georgia).

Macroeconomic measurement of a country's trade and transfers deficit.

Financial strategy offsetting risk of adverse price movements in assets.
Financial security with a value that relies upon an underlying asset.

Sustained decrease in the general price level of goods and services.
Coexistence of stagnant economic growth and high inflation.
